entities.summary: Indabibi, a ruler of ancient Elam, played a pivotal role in the annals of history as the successor of Tammaritu II and the predecessor of Humban-Haltash III. His reign occurred during the reign of Assyrian king Ashurbanipal, marking a significant moment in the complex web of power struggles between the Assyrian Empire and the smaller Elamite kingdom. This period of instability would have far-reaching consequences for the region, setting the stage for the eventual rise and fall of various dynasties.
